question: For loanDepot (NYSE: LDI) what is the breakdown of loan originations between purchases and refinancings for the last 9 months as of 11/12/2024?
model_answer:
For the **nine months ended September 30, 2024**—reported in loanDepot’s Q3 2024 earnings release and 10-Q filed **November 12, 2024**—loan origination volume by purpose was:

| Purpose | Volume ($ thousands) | % of total |
|---|---:|---:|
| **Purchase** | **$12,057,993** | **69.7%** |
| **Refinance — cash-out** | $4,660,580 | 26.9% |
| **Refinance — rate/term** | $589,741 | 3.4% |
| **Total refinancings** | **$5,250,321** | **30.3%** |
| **Total loan originations** | **$17,308,314** | **100.0%** |

So the breakdown was approximately **$12.06 billion of purchase originations (69.7%)** versus **$5.25 billion of refinancings (30.3%)**.
judge_reason: Purchase and refinance originations match the official figures exactly, with no contradiction.
